content.overview: Defamation protects reputation under Article 21. Requires defamatory statement, reference to plaintiff, and publication to a third party. Both libel and slander are actionable per se in India. Governed by 3 affirmative defences: Justification by Truth, Fair Comment, and Absolute/Qualified Privilege. Governed by a 1-year limitation period.
